visual_enhancers.zero_shadow_philosophy: Strict zero-shadow aesthetic mirroring high-end printed editorial monographs (Awwwards/Swiss style). Elevation achieved strictly via hairline borders and subtle paper shifts (#F8F7F4 vs #F1EEE7 vs #FFFFFF).
visual_enhancers.deliberate_accents: Electric Lime (#E0F65D) sparingly used for live status badges and BI active query nodes; high contrast Charcoal (#121212) for primary CTAs.

marquee.style: Editorial ribbon with slow drift, warm background, low contrast mono text

accessibility.contrast_check: All text combinations strictly meet or exceed WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 for body and 3:1 for large display titles). #121212 on #F8F7F4 delivers 17.5:1 ratio. #5A5751 muted text on #F8F7F4 delivers 5.4:1 ratio.
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Interactive items feature visible high-contrast focus rings: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#121212] focus:ring-offset-2
accessibility.screen_reader: All icon-only elements have aria-label, decorative icons have aria-hidden='true', all interactive and key data elements carry kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. EDITORIAL INTEGRITY: Maintain the warm off-white canvas (#F8F7F4) with deep ink typography (#121212) and hairline 1px borders (#E3DFD7). Strictly ZERO loud colored full-screen gradients. No purple/violet AI slop.
2. TYPOGRAPHY: Import Lora Variable for serif display headings and Instrument Sans Variable for crisp modern body text. Set line-height tight on display and relaxed on body copy.

3. CODE-BUILT MOCKUPS: In the Project Showcase section, render authentic browser frames, phone frames, and interactive BI dashboard previews built cleanly with Tailwind CSS and Recharts rather than relying on external image placeholders.

4. INTERACTIVE POWER BI DEMO: Implement a realistic, interactive mini BI dashboard component for the Power BI project card with working filter toggles (Revenue, Margin, Orders, Branch selector, MoM metrics) using preinstalled Recharts.
5. CV INTEGRATION: Render structured bento cards with clear visual hierarchy for Experience, Education, Technical Skills, Soft Skills, Certifications, and Activities/Events.

6. CONTACT SECTION: Keep it strictly recruiter-friendly with quick copy-to-clipboard actions for Email and Phone, and high-contrast links for LinkedIn, without cluttering with an unnecessary contact form.
7. TESTING ATTRIBUTES: Add data-testid to all navigation links, project filter tabs, project cards, modal triggers, CV download action, and contact buttons.
